surprises.title: Trim is rotten
surprises.description: Oh no! Your putty knife sinks right into the trim. It's basically wet bread.

options.text: Replace all the exterior trim on the house
Replace the rotted trim
Fill the rot with caulk

surprises.title: Sheathing is rotten
surprises.description: Trim off, and the plywood underneath is dark and crumbly. It's been wet for a long time.

options.text: Spray it with bleach and cover it up
Cut out and patch the sheathing
Re-sheathe the whole wall

surprises.title: Flashing is missing
surprises.description: Mystery solved: there's no flashing above the window. Water has been walking right in.

options.text: Run a bigger bead of caulk on top
Install flashing tape and a drip cap
Add an awning over every window

surprises.title: Window frame rots
surprises.description: The window frame is soft at the corners. This window may be beyond saving.

options.text: Replace every window in the house
Replace this window
Patch it with wood filler

surprises.title: Sill cracks
surprises.description: The sill is cracked and holding a little puddle. It's a tiny swimming pool for bugs.

options.text: Replace the sill
Install a whole new window
Drill drain holes in it

surprises.title: Draft blows through
surprises.description: You can feel a breeze through a finger-wide gap around the frame.

options.text: Fill it with low-expansion foam
Blow insulation into every wall
Fill it with regular expanding foam

surprises.title: Lead paint shows up
surprises.description: The test swab turned red. The trim paint has lead.

options.text: Set up containment and wet-scrape
Sand it off with a power sander
Hire a hazmat crew for the whole house

surprises.title: Other windows look sad
surprises.description: This window looks amazing. Every other window now looks sad by comparison.

options.text: Caulk the others next weekend
Caulk over the old caulk on all of them right now
Replace every window this month

surprises.title: Partner spots gutters
surprises.description: Your partner yells up: "While you're on the ladder, the gutters are overflowing!"

options.text: Install gutter guards on the whole house
Lean the ladder on the gutter and reach
Clean the gutter by this window

surprises.title: Trim profile doesn't match
surprises.description: The store's trim looks nothing like your 1950s trim. It's modern. Too modern.

options.text: Have a millwork shop match the profile
Install it anyway and squint
Replace the trim on every window to match

surprises.title: Stud rot spreads
surprises.description: Behind the bad sheathing, the stud next to the window is soft too.

options.text: Reframe the whole wall
Sister a new stud alongside
Fill the rot with expanding foam

surprises.title: Window size is odd
surprises.description: Your window is 31 3/8 inches wide. No store carries that. Custom order: 8 weeks.

options.text: Reframe the opening to a standard size
Order a custom window and protect the opening
Jam in a standard window with lots of shims

surprises.title: Interior stool cracks
surprises.description: Pulling the outside sill cracks the interior window stool. Now it's an inside job too.

options.text: Replace the interior stool
Redo all the interior window trim
Glue and clamp the crack

surprises.title: Window starts sticking
surprises.description: After foaming the gap, the window won't open. The frame bowed just a little.

options.text: Replace the window
Trim back the foam and adjust the shims
Force it open with a pry bar

surprises.title: Paint chips hit garden
surprises.description: A breeze carries lead paint chips straight into the vegetable garden.

options.text: Stop work, clean up, and test the soil
Rake them into the soil
Pave over the garden

surprises.title: Blinds look old
surprises.description: The clean window makes the yellowed blinds look like they lost a fight.

options.text: Take them down and tape up a bedsheet
Wash them for now
Install motorized shades on every window

ask.question: How do I re-caulk a window?
ask.answer: Simple! 1. Squeeze caulk on the old caulk. 2. Smooth it. 3. Done!
ask.skipped: It skipped scraping off the old caulk.
